remote_return.verification_method: Live read-only git ls-remote establishes current remote commit; local immutable Git objects addressed by that exact commit verify tree/blob SHA and contents; no new fetch or Git writes.

state_before_after_return.exact_difference: Current local state is the uploaded CLOSED state plus one git_return_attempts list, recorded by parent after return helper completed.

process_resource_closure.scan_criteria: Non-zombie same-host /proc entries; argv executable starts python/pypy; .py argv basename contains rootcause_worker, diagnostic_worker, validation_worker, parallel_b_supervisor, quantum, or pyscf. Audit stdin Python and shell argument text are excluded.
